summary: Grande Group Ltd/HK filed a Form 6-K on July 6, 2026, reporting the resignation of executive director Ying Wo Sammy Ho (April 15, 2026, for personal reasons, no disagreement) and the appointment of Sha Xia as director effective July 1, 2026. Ms. Xia will receive an annual salary of HK$180,000 (~US$23,077) per a one-year employment agreement. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The vacancy was filled on a routine basis; however, the filing constitutes a forced/abrupt departure of a prior director, triggering Management Changes classification. Watch for any subsequent disclosures regarding strategic shifts or other governance changes.
